name: agent-writing-studio
description: A writing studio an AI agent runs for Vietnamese text, from blank page to delivery. Five axes: a context architect that refuses to write until the brief is real, a co-writer that declares every machine-written sentence, a critic that scores per criterion with quotable evidence and no total score, an editor that moves prose toward the author's own voice without touching facts, and a forensic reader with two modes — audit against the self-declaration, or blind for calibration only. Genres are data files with a fixed schema; nine profiles included (essay, research, novel, journalism, blog, and four Vietnamese institutional forms). Integrity comes from provenance that travels with the text, not from a detector score.
